argv: Onset feed lights reader and lights flash envelope (decision 0031)

Product half of accepted decision 0031 (user acceptance 2026-10-17). Adds RADIO_ACTIVITY_READER_LIGHTS to CM7/App/radio_activity_feed so the lights renderer takes onsets without stealing them from Classic's activity hold or the matrix (item 10), and a portable flash envelope for items 5-8: onset size 1-3 raises perceived lightness by that many thirds of the range from the current level to full, the boost falls one third per 80 ms continuously, a smaller onset than the boost in progress is ignored, an equal or larger one restarts it; step fraction and decay configurable. Exemptions of items 2-3 (held button, breathing Button 0, fault blink, prompt, Shift, Instrument) are the renderer's inputs and are host-tested where the envelope applies them. Updates presentation.md: a lights row for radio onsets and the Open behavior row narrowed to EMF and warnings on the direct LEDs. Lands on main; the demo consumer is a separate track-demo task.

radio_activity_feed_test shows each of the three readers sees every onset once; host tests cover step sizes, continuous decay, the smaller-onset rule and restart; presentation.md updated in the same change; Debug and Release build; native host tests pass.
Demo: encoder and button lights flash on radio onsets (decision 0031)

Demo consumer of accepted decision 0031 on the M7 lights (decision 0011 item 12). demo_lights takes onsets from the new lights reader (54w.8.1) and applies the flash envelope to every lit encoder and button in Field: encoders keep their hue with channels scaled together; no flash on a held button, on Button 0 while breathing or blinking its fault, while the prompt is open, while Shift is held, or in Instrument. Lights update independently of the 50/100 ms OLED compose so an 80 ms decay step reads as a fade (timer compare writes only). Builds on p04.12 encoder PWM levels. Narrows 54w.5 (M4 lights rendering) and 54w.8; a demo task never closes them.

Host tests for the demo lights exemptions; on the demo image, lit encoders and buttons flash with radio onsets in step with the matrix kicks and never in the prompt, Shift or Instrument; visible on camera; recording regression clean on the demo image; Demo/Debug/Release build; bench evidence in docs/evidence/.

Host test monitor_ptt_test does not build with GCC (-Werror=type-limits)
